description: VTID-05276, VTID-05408, VTID-05765 (plan autonomous-to-staging), VTID-05780 (plan autonomous-to-staging-r2): protected gate files. A change to one merges only with two reviewer-agent accepts from two different chain models and two different reviewer sessions (never a builder session) on the exact merged head, every check green and the gate-invariants check passing (land-guard.mjs mergeDecision, governance.ts). Lanes that change one carry protected_gate: two-model from a trusted source. Globs use scripts/collab/queue.mjs globToRegex semantics. Owned by scripts/collab/queue.mjs (compiled-in copy for single-file runs); the Project Manager mirrors it in governance.ts.
